text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report recommends prohibiting standing at all times on the south side of Scottfield Drive, between Middlefield Road and Finch Avenue East. Currently, parking is permitted for a maximum period of three hours on both sides of Scottfield Drive.

Scarborough Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times on the south side of Scottfield Drive, between a point 62 metres east of Middlefield Road and a point 49 metres further east. 2. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times on the south side of Scottfield Drive, between a point 239 metres east of Middlefield Road and a point 52 metres further east. 3. Rescinded the existing standing prohibition in effect at all times on the south side of Scottfield Drive, between a point 138 metres east of Middlefield Road and a point 78 metres further east. 4. Prohibited standing at all times on the south side of Scottfield Drive, between Middlefield Road and Finch Avenue East.
